channels: all 14 EEG channels in source order
epoch: cue-relative [0,4) seconds, 1000 samples; confirm event alignment using source documentation and Session 1 only before opening Session 2
signal_processing: source acquisition filtering retained; no additional broadband filtering, artifact rejection, variance normalization or dataset-level fitting; scale volts to microvolts once if source is in volts
source_session: first session, both runs, 150 trials per subject expected
target_session: second session, both runs, evaluated once after selection lock; third session not used
architecture_and_optimization: frozen OpenBMI recipe; only num_channels=14, classes=3 and dataset paths change
selection: two-fold leave-one-Session-1-run-out validation; selected epoch is rounded median of fold optima; fresh full-Session-1 retraining for that duration
primary_contrast: subject-macro Session-2 accuracy, RD minus NoDemean
inferential_unit: subject; average seeds within each subject before paired contrasts
uncertainty: paired subject bootstrap 100000 draws, seed 20260927; enumerate all 16 subject sign flips for descriptive p value
exclusions: none based on convergence, accuracy or Session-2 outcome
release_gate: hash source files, preprocessing code, processed Session-1 arrays, configs and all selected epochs before any Session-2 epoch extraction or model evaluation
interpretation: only four subjects; this is a later independently locked external replication, not a new prospective confirmation of the original OpenBMI hypothesis
